context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss about formal writing
purpose: Teach: にあたる/氏名/もとより/に関しまして/均等/奨励/分配/遺憾

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本日はお時間を頂戴し、誠に恐縮です。新年度の社内報にあたる文書の書き方について、ご指導いただけますでしょうか。
lines.en: Thank you for your time today. Could you advise me on how to write the document that serves as our new fiscal year internal newsletter?
lines.style: Polite junior executive seeking mentorship, slightly nervous tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: もとより喜んで協力するつもりだよ。まず、宛名の氏名は必ずフルネームで、役職を添えること。これが基本中の基本だ。
lines.en: Of course, I am glad to help. First, the addressee's full name must always be written out completely, with their title attached. This is the most fundamental rule.
lines.style: Warm but firm elder statesman, instructive and measured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。実は配当金の分配方法に関しまして、社員へ説明する文章で苦労しております。
lines.en: I see. Actually, I have been struggling with the wording when explaining the method of dividend distribution to our employees.
lines.style: Honest admission of difficulty, respectful junior tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そこは要注意だな。利益を均等に扱う姿勢を強調しつつ、貢献に応じた奨励の仕組みも明示する。曖昧さは禍根を残す。
lines.en: That requires great care. Emphasize a stance of treating profits equitably, while also clearly stating the incentive structure based on contribution. Ambiguity leaves lasting trouble.
lines.style: Seasoned advice with strategic framing and deliberate cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 先月の通達では言葉足らずで、現場に混乱を招いてしまい、私としても遺憾に思っております。
lines.en: Last month's announcement was poorly worded and caused confusion on the floor, which I personally find deeply regrettable.
lines.style: Genuine contrition, formal self-reflective register, signature delivery that holds the line

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 失敗を認められるのは経営者の器だよ。詫びる文書では、まず事実を述べ、次に対策、最後に決意を示す。順序が肝心だ。
lines.en: Acknowledging failure shows a leader's capacity. In an apology document, first state the facts, then countermeasures, and finally your resolve. The order is what matters.
lines.style: Encouraging mentor sharing practical wisdom, paternal warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 胸に刻みます。最後に、社外向けの挨拶状で気をつけるべき点はございますでしょうか。
lines.en: I will engrave that in my heart. Lastly, what points should I be careful about in greeting letters intended for external recipients?
lines.style: Sincere request for final guidance, deferential closing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 派手な美辞麗句より、誠実さだ。相手への敬意を一文ごとに込めれば、文章はおのずと整う。焦らず、一通ずつ丁寧にな。
lines.en: Sincerity matters more than flowery rhetoric. If you put respect into every sentence, the writing arranges itself naturally. Take your time, one letter at a time.
lines.style: Closing wisdom with gentle paternal encouragement, unhurried.
